get.description: Lists the active login providers.
Starts a login with the provider and redirects back to returnUrl (an app-relative path) afterwards.

post.description: Ends the session (and the IdP session for OIDC logins) and redirects to the login page.

get.description: 200 while the instance owner is unclaimed and the first-run setup is available, otherwise 404.

post.description: Claims the instance owner: sets user name, display name and password, grants admin and signs in.
Signs in with user name and password.
WebAuthn request options (PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions JSON) for passkey login.
Signs in with a passkey assertion (PublicKeyCredential JSON).
WebAuthn creation options (PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions JSON) to add a passkey to the signed-in user.
Stores a passkey attestation for the signed-in user.

get.description: The current user: id, display name, roles and scopes.
A token for the X-XSRF-TOKEN header of state-changing requests. Fetch a new one after login or logout.
Server-sent live updates for the comma-separated topics (event name = event type, data = LiveEventMessage).
The user's runs (voice, web, task, api), newest first or slowest time to first delta first (sort=timeToFirstDelta); filter by source, outcome, rating and minimum cost, page with before.
One run: context build, model calls, tool calls with guard decisions, taint sources and the reply.
Cost per day and tier in the user's time zone, advisor separately (default: the last 30 days).

put.description: Rates one of the user's runs up or down with an optional note; with "help Marshal learn" on, the first rating also creates an eval case.

delete.description: Removes the rating of a run; an eval case made from it stays.

post.description: Snapshots a run as an eval case, whatever the learning preference says; returns the existing case when there is one.

get.description: The app version, the supported and deprecated API versions and the event sources.
The current health warnings (codes, components, messages in German and English). Changes are published on the health live topic.
Loaded skills, templates, MCP servers, risk rules, models and satellites, plus the last load error per file.

post.description: Runs one conversation turn and streams the reply as server-sent events (delta, status, artifact, final; web sessions also reasoning and tool).

get.description: The user's conversations (web, voice, api), newest last turn first; page with before (a lastTurnAt) and limit.
One conversation: its turns and background results in time order.
The user's notifications, newest first, with channel, outcome and reason; filter by outcome, page with before.
The artifact's content (session or token).
A PNG preview within 480 × 270 pixels for 3D models and images; 404 for other kinds.
The artifact's content through a signed, expiring link; no sign-in.

post.description: Copies a printer snapshot into the artifact store, outside the snapshot retention.

Runs one AI task (multipart: a 'task' JSON part with taskName, instructions, optional structure and language; optional 'attachment' image parts) and answers with its data: a string, or an object matching structure.
Receives a webhook of a source (e.g. uptime-kuma) and publishes its events.

get.description: The user's API tokens without secrets; executor callback tokens are read-only.

post.description: Creates a token with scopes the user holds; the plaintext is returned only in this response.

delete.description: Revokes one of the user's tokens.

get.description: Every secret visible to the user (own, instance, environment) without values, plus unresolved references.

put.description: Creates or replaces one of the user's secrets.

delete.description: Deletes one of the user's secrets.

get.description: Instance secrets (database and environment) without values.

put.description: Creates or replaces an instance secret.

get.description: Language, time zone, quiet hours, notification targets and do-not-disturb of the user.
Eval cases, newest first.
One eval case with its history, turn context, recorded tool calls and reply.

put.description: Sets the expected behavior note of a case (at most 1,000 characters).

post.description: Estimated model cost of replaying the cases with the candidate configuration.

get.description: Eval runs with their totals, newest first.

post.description: Starts an eval run: replays the cases one at a time in the background without executing any tool.

get.description: An eval run with its totals and per case the replayed calls, reply, outcome and judge score.

delete.description: Deletes an eval run and its results.

post.description: Cancels a queued or running eval run.

get.description: MCP tools that are new or changed since the last approval, with the previous and current definitions.

post.description: Approves (the current definition becomes trusted) or rejects (hidden until it changes again) a waiting MCP tool.

get.description: Chunks newest first, or ranked by relevance with query; filter by type, scope, projectId, pinned and closed.

post.description: Writes a chunk through its deterministic id (an existing chunk with the same identity is updated).

get.description: A chunk (also when deleted) with its earlier versions and its edges.

put.description: Changes content, importance, source and valid time; the previous content becomes a version.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a chunk; it is no longer retrieved.

put.description: Pins a chunk: it is injected in full in every turn.

post.description: Writes a replacement with a new identity and a supersedes edge to the chunk.

get.description: Predecessors, earlier versions and the current content, oldest first.
Stale chunks, open contradictions, orphans, dangling edges and open proposals.
Open proposals of the idle-time jobs (contradictions and duplicates), oldest first.

post.description: Applies a proposal: closes the outdated chunk, or merges the duplicates.
Dismisses a proposal; memory stays unchanged and the pair is not proposed again.

get.description: Live chunks and the edges between them, for the force-directed graph.
Live chunks' embeddings projected onto their first two principal components.
Chunks, versions, edges and projects as NDJSON (without embeddings).
Live projects with aliases, alias candidates and chunk counts.

post.description: Creates a project; names are unique.

delete.description: Deletes a project; its chunks stay and show up as orphans in the audit.

post.description: Adds an active alias (or activates an existing candidate).

put.description: Promotes or rejects an alias or alias candidate.

delete.description: Removes an alias or alias candidate.

get.description: The project's correction log, newest first.
Configured printers with their live state (null while offline), allowlisted macros and babysitter state (null when not enabled).
Live state from the websocket cache.
Printable files, newest first.
The job queue.
Recent jobs, newest first.

post.description: Runs a safe control, or freezes a confirm-tier control and returns its confirmation token.
Runs a frozen control with the token from the confirmation dialog (single use, expires).
Takes, resizes and stores a webcam snapshot.

get.description: A stored snapshot as JPEG.
A stored snapshot as JPEG without signing in, with the signature of a shared link (push notification images; expires after a day).
The webcam's live stream, proxied so the browser never contacts the printer.
The speaker's queue as the music widget shows it: state, current and next item, item count, shuffle and repeat.

post.description: Runs a playback control (pause, resume, next, previous, stop, volume) through the guard, recorded as a run with trigger widget:music.

get.description: An MCP app a turn showed: server, tool, the call's arguments and result, and whether it can still be shown.

post.description: Calls a tool of the app's own server for the app, through the guard as a run with trigger app:<server>/<tool>; confirm tier is denied.

get.description: The user's mail accounts without credentials.

post.description: Adds an IMAP account; the password becomes a write-only owner secret.

delete.description: Removes an account and its stored credential.

get.description: OAuth providers and whether this instance has a client for them.

post.description: Starts connecting an account: returns the provider's sign-in URL for the browser.

get.description: Undecided approvals of the user's background tasks, oldest first, with reasons and taint sources.

post.description: Executes the frozen action and resumes the task with its result.
Resumes the task with the rejection; nothing is executed.

get.description: Pending input requests of MCP servers, oldest first.
One input request in any status.

post.description: Answers an input request (form fields, or null when a URL request is done), repeats the frozen call once and resumes the waiting task with its outcome.
Declines an input request; nothing is sent to the server and the waiting task resumes with the refusal.

get.description: The user's tasks and watches, oldest first; status filters by one status or active (pending, running, waiting).
Whether background work is stopped.

post.description: Stops every unfinished agent task and pauses new ones until released.
Lets background tasks run again; tasks paused while it was active become due.

get.description: One task with notes, the latest result, deliveries, recent runs, notifications and executor sessions.

put.description: Replaces the task's goal; the next run uses it.
Replaces the task's tool policy (tool ids or globs inside its template's allowlist); the next run sees only those tools.

post.description: Cancels the task and its unfinished child tasks.

get.description: The user's proposals, newest first, without diffs (default: open ones; status=all for every one).
One proposal with its diff.

post.description: Merges the change into the branch it started from on the executor host; a conflict leaves it open.
Rejects the change and drops its branch on the executor host.

get.description: The user's open suggestions, newest first.

post.description: Accepts a suggestion; its proposed action, if any, runs once through the guard.
Dismisses a suggestion; nothing runs.

get.description: Every detector with the user's counts, acceptance estimate and mute.

put.description: Mutes a detector until a time, or indefinitely without one.

post.description: Sets a detector's counts back to zero; a mute stays.

get.description: Open and downloaded skill proposals, newest first.
One skill proposal with its SKILL.md and diff.
The drafted SKILL.md as a file; marks the proposal downloaded.

post.description: Dismisses a skill proposal; the same workflow is not proposed again.

get.description: Maintenance items read now: due first, then soon, then by name; empty without configured items.

post.description: Marks a maintenance item done: its usage starts again from the counter's current value.

get.description: The owner's artifacts, newest first, filtered by kind, source and name, with the quota usage.

post.description: Uploads one file (multipart field 'file'), at most artifacts.maxUploadMb.

get.description: One of the user's artifacts: metadata, source, taint and content URL.

delete.description: Deletes one of the user's artifacts.

attachment.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP images; repeat the part for several.

AiTaskForm.description: The multipart form of an AI task (OpenAPI description only).

data.description: A string without structure; an object matching the structure otherwise.

AiTaskResponse.description: The answer of an AI task.

readOnly.description: True for tokens users cannot manage (executor callback tokens).

ApiTokenResponse.description: A machine token without its secret.

tool.description: The tool name as the server reports it.

toolCallId.description: The tool call that showed the app.

result.description: The call's `CallToolResult`; null when it was too large to keep.

available.description: The app can be shown: the result is complete and the server still serves its UI.

taskId.description: The task that waits for the decision; null for an approval of a run without a task (an AI task).

runId.description: The run that asked; with a taint source's first step it links to the tool result that tainted the run.

arguments.description: Frozen arguments; approving executes exactly these.

reasons.description: Why it needs approval, verbatim, the main one first.

taint.description: Untrusted sources the run had read, with the step that brought each in.

ApprovalItem.description: A background approval in the review queue.

name.description: The tool name as the app's server reports it.

ArtifactList.description: Artifacts with the owner's storage usage.

sourceReference.description: Task, message or printer snapshot it came from.

tainted.description: Content or name can carry third-party text.

validFrom.description: Since when it is true; with it, the valid time is set exactly as sent (null `ValidTo` reopens the chunk).

ChunkEditRequest.description: New content of a chunk; identity fields cannot change (supersede instead).

title.description: Short English title (part of the identity).

validFrom.description: Since when it is true (default: now).

validTo.description: Until when it is true; null leaves it open.

ChunkWriteRequest.description: A chunk to write (create or supersede replacement).

message.description: What is wrong (never contains secret values).

previousVersionActive.description: True when the previous version of the file stays active; false when the entry is skipped.

ConfigError.description: A config file whose last load failed.

templates.description: Loaded agent templates, including the built-in default unless replaced.

mcpServers.description: Configured MCP servers with their connection status.

riskRules.description: Active risk rules in evaluation order (first match wins).

models.description: Configured models; API keys by secret name only.

conversationId.description:
Token clients: their own conversation id (required). Browser sessions: Marshal's session id
from an earlier final event; omitted starts a new conversation.

text.description: What the user said or typed.

language.description: Request language (`de` or `en`); the reply uses it.

haUserId.description: Home Assistant user id, if known.

inputMode.description: `voice` when the turn went through speech-to-text, otherwise `text`.

followupRef.description: Opaque reference from a voice follow-up; unknown values are ignored.

name.description: Label, e.g. the client using it.

scopes.description: Scopes to grant; each must be one the user holds.

token.description: The plaintext; shown only in this response.

port.description: IMAP port (993 for TLS, 143 for STARTTLS).

draftsFolder.description: Drafts folder when the server marks none with `\Drafts`.

CreateMailAccountRequest.description: A new IMAP account with a password or app password. The password becomes a write-only owner secret.

enabled.description: Unconfigured integrations are simulated and demo data is seeded.

showBadge.description: Show the "Demo" badge in the navigation.

DemoInfo.description: Demo mode as the UI needs it.

sent.description: Suggestions sent since the last reset.

mutedUntil.description: End of the mute; null when indefinite or not muted.

DetectorItem.description: One detector's counts for the user.

EvalCandidateView.description: The candidate configuration of an eval run.

note.description: The note; empty or null removes it.

EvalCaseNoteRequest.description: The expected behavior note of an eval case.

estimatedCost.description: Estimated model cost of the replays and judge calls.

results.description: Per case result in replay order.

EvalRunReport.description: An eval run and its case results.

models.description: Configured model key per tier (`fast`, `standard`, `advisor`); tiers left out use the current routing.

basePrompt.description: Replaces Marshal's base instructions; null keeps them.

judgeModel.description: Configured model key that scores replies; null for no judge.

EvalRunRequest.description: Cases and the candidate configuration of an eval run.

EvalRunView.description: An eval run with its totals.

connected.description: Whether it currently receives events (webhook sources: a webhook arrived in the last 24 hours).

webhook.description: Whether it is a webhook source (`POST /api/v1/hooks/{source}`).

lastReceivedAt.description: When it last received a webhook; null for other sources or before the first one.

HealthMessageView.description: A message in Marshal's two languages.

link.description: Path in the web UI with details (e.g. `/system/config`), if any.

sessionId.description: Conversation the request came from, if any.

taskId.description: The task that resumes with the outcome.

expiresAt.description: When the request expires (nothing is sent to the server then).

type.description: Event type, e.g. `run.completed` (also the SSE event name).

untrusted.description: Its tool output taints the run.

toolName.description: Tool name as the server reports it.

edges.description: Edges from and to the chunk.

MemoryChunkDetail.description: A chunk with its history data.

displayName.description: Name used in the UI and the system prompt.

scopes.description: Scopes: granted by the roles for cookie sessions, the token's own for tokens.

demo.description: Whether the instance runs in demo mode and shows the badge.

apiKeySecret.description: Secret name of the API key, if any.

action.description: pause, resume, next, previous, stop or volume.

action.description:
start_print, pause, resume, cancel, emergency_stop, set_temperature, home, move, run_macro,
queue_add, queue_remove, queue_clear, queue_pause, queue_start or queue_jump.

axes.description: x, y and / or z for home (all when empty).

axis.description: x, y or z for move.

note.description: What should have happened (at most 1,000 characters).

denyTools.description: Tool globs hidden on this satellite.

updatedAt.description: Last change of a database secret.

SecretValueRequest.description: A secret value to store. It is never returned.

SkillProposalSummary.description: A skill proposal in the Inbox list.

files.description: Additional files, relative to the skill.

email.description: The mailbox address (the IMAP login name).

snippet.description: Text to show verbatim below the suggestion (a YAML snippet); null for none.

actionSummary.description: What Accept runs; null without a proposed action.

warnings.description: Errors first, then by component and code; empty when everything is fine.

version.description: App version (informational version, including the commit when built from source).

supportedApiVersions.description: API versions this build serves, e.g. `1.0`.

eventSources.description: What publishes events on the event bus (HA, printers, mail, webhook sources).

executorSessions.description: External work it started, newest first.

goal.description: The goal the next run works on.

statusReason.description: Why it is in that state (e.g. `budget_exceeded`, `paused`).

trigger.description: What makes it due; watches have kind `event`.

spent.description: What the current activation has used.

resultSpeech.description: The spoken part of the latest result.

resultAt.description: When the latest result was ready.

before.description: How long before each scheduled run the preparation runs.

nextAt.description: When the next preparation run is due.

preparedAt.description: When the prepared notes waiting for the next run were collected, if any.

tools.description: Tool ids or globs (e.g. `printer.*`) inside the task's template allowlist.

modelTier.description: Fixed model tier; null = by input mode.

tools.description: Tool id globs it may use.

skills.description: Skills it may use; null = all.

language.description: `de` or `en`; used when a request has no language.
